Privacy Policy

A clear explanation of how this ordering website stores and uses customer information.

On this page Information we collect How we use it Browser storage Contact us
Last updatedSeptember 2, 2026
Important

This website is currently a frontend demonstration. Orders and customer details are stored only in the customer's browser and are not sent to a Coffee Bridge server.

01

Information We Collect

When you place a demonstration order, you may enter your name, phone number, order instructions, selected drinks, customizations, and payment-method preference.

02

How We Use Your Information

  • To display your cart, checkout summary, and receipt
  • To remember your selected website language
  • To generate a local order number for the demonstration
03

Cookies and Browser Storage

The site uses localStorage—not a remote database—to remember the cart, language, order sequence, and latest receipt. You can remove this information by clearing this site's browser data.

04

Contact Us

If you have questions about this policy, contact Coffee Bridge using the contact information on the homepage.
